chunks: And whatever was in it from Ayyub ibn A‘yan, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Sa‘d ibn ‘Abd Allah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from al-Hakam ibn Miskin, from Ayyub ibn A‘yan.

key_terms.أَبِي: my father; the author’s immediate transmitter in this chain
key_terms.أَيُّوبَ بْنِ أَعْيَنَ: the narrator to whom this transmission path leads
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicating formal narration through a sanad/isnad
key_terms.سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: an important transmitter in the documented chain

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Ayyub ibn A‘yan in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Ayyub ibn A‘yan in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih. Its significance lies in documenting the line of transmission and preserving the source-path of the hadith material.
